scope: sequential frozen national504 plus context28 control of final package

disk_basis.note: The preliminary 64GiB recommendation assumed an unvalidated 32GiB per-task floor. Final policy uses the historical accepted 12GiB floor and 32GiB at start, retaining reserve beyond observed output and archive. No automatic deletion or expansion follows from this policy.

time_basis.note: The approximately40min old workflow used six workers. The final sequential adapter is estimated from sum of task durations, not that parallel wall time. Actual new full-run duration remains unmeasured.
